subject: village blacksmith's forge: a waist-high rectangular hearth of rough grey fieldstone laid in lime mortar, a bed of glowing orange charcoal on its top, a smoke hood of the same fieldstone corbelled out over the coals and carrying a short square stone chimney, a big leather bellows on a weathered oak frame at the hearth's left side, and a dark wrought-iron anvil on a squat oak stump at its right side
